vectors.title: Production wallet intake, initialization, and fixture funding
vectors.applicability: Required within the declared evaluation scope; complete-program coverage is reported separately from the initial ToDo sequence.
preconditions: Digest-verified production wallet and application artifacts
Reviewed production-fidelity intake and declared mainnet configuration
Qualified ITCVE service dependencies, isolated fixture identity, and initial-state evidence
steps: Verify the unchanged production-release artifact and its installation identity.
Initialize through ordinary supported user interfaces with mainnet selected and explicitly configured ITCVE services.
Establish fixture output ownership, provenance, and declared spending eligibility against the controlled service model.
expected: The artifact and configuration match the reviewed intake record. No special wallet build or regtest support is required.
Runtime observations identify which service boundaries are controlled and which are unresolved.
Fixture funding is distinguished from public-mainnet funds and acceptance.
blockers: Supported endpoint coverage confirmed in the installed release
Mainnet-format fixture and independent service-state oracle
